    meta:
        description = "Detects known Cobalt Strike beacon shellcode patterns in memory or files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2019/04/cobalt-strike-beacon-detection.html"
        tlp = "amber"

        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-by-SA 4.0"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 61 00 62 00 63 00 } // wide "abc" - common in beacon configs
        $b = { 6D 65 6D 63 70 79 } // "memcpy"
        $c = { E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 04 85 C0 74 ?? 6A 00 } // common beacon call pattern
        $d = /POST [^ ]+\/ HTTP\/1\.1\r\nHost:/ nocase
    condition:
        all of ($a, $b) or ($c and $d)
}
